---
title: "check-math-definitions.yml"
---

Check for duplicate, divergent, or colliding mathematical definitions
and theorems across Quarto (`.qmd`) and Markdown (`.md`) files
and sibling repositories.

In multi-repo textbook and curriculum ecosystems,
mathematical entities
(definitions, theorems, lemmas, corollaries,
propositions, conjectures, exercises)
are frequently cited or duplicated across books and course repositories.
`check-math-definitions` scans cross-reference divs (`::: {#def-name}`)
to enforce cross-document consistency:

1. **Exact ID Divergence:** Flags when the same cross-reference ID
   (e.g. `#def-variance`) appears in multiple files or repositories
   with divergent or conflicting mathematical definitions.
   Identical content is treated as canonical and passes cleanly.
2. **Conceptual / Title Collisions:** Flags when the same mathematical concept
   title (e.g. "Variance") is defined under multiple distinct IDs
   within the same prefix category.
3. **In-Repo Duplicate IDs:** Flags when the same ID is defined more than once
   in the same repository.

A single div opts out with a directive comment inside that div,
on its opening fence line or in its own body:

```markdown
<!-- check-math-definitions: allow-divergence -->
<!-- check-math-definitions: opt-out -->
```

It exempts that div only.
Other divs in the same file are still checked,
and a directive inside a nested div exempts the nested div
rather than the one enclosing it.

A whole file opts out with the separate file-level directive,
placed anywhere in the file:

```markdown
<!-- check-math-definitions: ignore-file -->
```

## Inputs

| Input | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | string | `'.'` | Target directory or file path to scan. |
| `paths` | string | `''` | Comma- or newline-separated list of directories to scan. |
| `repos` | string | `''` | Comma- or newline-separated list of GitHub repos (`owner/repo`) to clone and scan. |
| `paths-ignore` | string | `'.git, .github, tests, test, vendor, scratch, _site, node_modules, .pytest_cache, .venv, venv'` | Comma- or newline-separated paths or glob patterns to ignore. |
| `extensions` | string | `'.qmd, .md, .rmd, .Rmd'` | Comma- or space-separated list of file extensions to check. |
| `prefixes` | string | `'def, thm, lem, cor, prp, cnj, exr, exm, rem, sol, clm'` | Comma- or space-separated list of div ID prefixes to track. |
| `check-titles` | boolean | `true` | Whether to flag matching titles with divergent IDs across repositories. |
| `fail` | boolean | `true` | Whether to fail the workflow if divergence or duplicate IDs are detected. |
| `python-version` | string | `'3.x'` | Python version to set up. |

## Permissions

Only `contents: read` (the default), so no extra permissions are required.

## Example

```yaml
name: Check Math Definitions
on:
  push: { branches: [main] }
  pull_request:
jobs:
  check:
    uses: Morrison-Lab/gha/.github/workflows/check-math-definitions.yml@v3
    with:
      repos: 'Morrison-Lab/rme, Morrison-Lab/pds'
```

See the [`examples/`](https://github.com/Morrison-Lab/gha/tree/main/examples)
directory for caller stubs.
